name: Highmere
descriptionSeed: An elven sky city that drifts above the high ground at the Pattern Reach's edge. The Figurists say it is held up by an idea; the elves say that is the same thing, and come down to the Pattern Reach to argue the point.
encounterFlavor: elven envoys, Figurist scholars staring upward, and people waiting under the stair
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own mountain (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind").
appearance: White towers on a floating island of rock, waterfalls running off its edges and becoming cloud before they land, and a long pale stair that only reaches the ground when Highmere wants it to.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
